'''Art Wright''' is a member of [[Team Albany]]. Matt Sokol's [[DecipherCon 2000]] trip report names him among the Albany players who flew to Kissimmee early and, with [[Aaron Kingery]] and [[Brian Terwilliger]], built Sokol's Day 3 [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list overnight before the Final Confrontation.<ref name="sokol-dt">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-sokols-dcon-2000-reportd1327/ sokols-dcon-2000-report], Matt Sokol, Decktech (11 October 2000)</ref>
